senses.gloss: f. (לות, denom. of לְוָת, to join, attach, v. P. Sm. 1920)

units: Yeb. 29ᵃ גזירה אחותה משום ל׳ דידה they made her sister subject to Ḥălitsah (v. חֲלִיצָה) on account of her associate in the case (i.e. her sister).

senses.gloss: that which clings to a person, fate, luck.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 20b:3">B. Mets. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>משום לְתָאִי דידי פקע</he> the cedar column burst in my luck (to avenge the wrong done me).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 106a:6">Ib. 106ᵃ</cite> <he>משום לְתָאָךְ הוא</he> (<he>לָתָךְ דידך</he>) it happened in thy (bad) luck; <he>משום לתאי</he> in my bad luck.
